title: Guji Uraga has landed
summary: Peach, jasmine and a lot of it — eleven bags off the boat, and the last lot we will see from this washing station this year.
body:
Eleven bags cleared the port on Friday and were on the roaster by Monday, which is about as short as that gap ever gets.

It is the same washing station as last year and the same varietal, but a later picking, and it shows: more peach than apricot, and the jasmine that was a note last season is most of the top end this time.

We buy this lot once a year and it does not repeat. When it is gone the shelf goes back to the Ethiopian we can get all year round, which is a good coffee that nobody writes a post about. The rest of what we are buying is filed under [sourcing](/blog/tags/sourcing/).
